empty.description: Log your first flight and this page fills up with trends, records and breakdowns of your flying.

sections.overviewHint: How much you have flown, and how that has built up over time.
sections.experienceHint: How your time splits across roles, conditions and the people you fly with.
sections.aircraftHint: Where your hours sit across types, registrations, classes and categories.
sections.placesHint: The airports, countries and routes your logbook covers.
sections.instrumentHint: IFR time, approaches and night flying.
sections.patternsHint: When you fly, and how long your flights tend to be.

chart.careerHoursHint: Running total of block time, including hours carried forward from before your logbook.
chart.monthlyHoursHint: Block time logged in each calendar month.
chart.timeBreakdownHint: Each category as a share of your total block time.
chart.overlapNote: Categories overlap — solo time is also PIC time, and night and IFR time can fall in any role.
chart.baselineNote: Carried-forward hours count toward the totals only — the breakdowns by year, aircraft and airport cover logged flights.
chart.roleByYearHint: PIC, dual received and SIC add up to your block time for the year.
chart.crewHint: Block time on flights with each logged crew member.
chart.byClassHint: Classes come from the aircraft records in your fleet.
chart.byCategoryHint: A flight can count in more than one category.
chart.topAirportsHint: Flights touching each airport, as departure or arrival.
chart.countriesHint: Where the airports you have visited are.
chart.topRoutesHint: Departure and arrival pairs, most frequent first.
chart.dayOfWeekHint: Which days you tend to fly on.
chart.seasonalityHint: Flights by calendar month, across all years in range.
chart.flightLengthHint: How your flights are distributed by block time.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Download your flight data, or take your whole logbook somewhere else.
export.layoutSingle: Single page (all columns on one page)
export.moveSubtitle: Your logbook is yours. Take it with you whenever you want — no export fees, no waiting period, no need to ask.
export.archiveDescription: Everything this account holds, as a documented ZIP of plain CSV and JSON: flights, aircraft, licences, ratings, medicals, contacts, crew and instructor signatures. Readable in any spreadsheet or text editor, with no NinerLog software. This is the only export that loses nothing — download it alongside whichever file your new logbook needs.
export.unverifiedHint: Built from this product's published import template, but not yet confirmed against a live import. If it does not load, please tell us — we will fix it.
export.lossyNotice: Each of these files only carries what that product can store. None of them carries your licences, medicals, contacts or the hours you flew before this logbook — download the complete archive above for those.
export.csvDescription: Export all flights as a CSV file. Choose a column format for your authority.
export.jsonDescription: Export everything — flights, aircraft, licences, class ratings, and credentials as a JSON backup file.
export.pdfDescription: Generate a formatted logbook PDF. Print it, sign it, and use it as a paper logbook.
export.importDescription: Import flights from ForeFlight, CSV files, or other logbook exports. Auto-detects format and column mapping.
export.aboutArchive: Complete archive — every record, in open CSV and JSON with a manifest. Nothing is left behind.
export.aboutTargets: Per-product files — ready to upload straight into ForeFlight, LogTen Pro, MyFlightbook or CrewLounge PILOTLOG, with no column mapping.
export.aboutCsvStandard: CSV Standard — ForeFlight-style columns with all flight fields. Opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app.
export.aboutCsvEasa: CSV EASA — AMC1 FCL.050 column layout (24 columns: SP-SE/ME, Multi-Pilot, PIC Name, Co-Pilot, Instructor, FSTD).
export.aboutCsvFaa: CSV FAA — ASA/Jeppesen standard logbook columns with decimal hours.
export.aboutPdfEasa: PDF EASA — full AMC1 FCL.050 compliant logbook with SP-SE/ME split, FSTD sessions, and page totals.
export.aboutPdfFaa: PDF FAA — standard ASA/Jeppesen layout with approaches, holds, and IPC/Flight Review markers.
export.aboutJson: JSON Backup — complete data snapshot including aircraft fleet, licences with class ratings, and credentials.
export.aboutYourData: Your data is yours — export anytime, no restrictions, no fees.
